name: Tribunus Compute Kernel
description: Build a Rust-native governed local compute substrate for inference, embeddings, reranking, and KV-cache management. Copy-honest execution with explicit materialization receipts. Metal-first for Apple Silicon, with backend routing for CUDA, HIP/ROCm, and Vulkan/WebGPU. Established by ADR 0019 (proposed).
objective: Phase 1 delivers the data plane: storage handles, tensor views, buffer pools, explicit materialization boundaries, and copy-honesty receipts. Phase 2 adds the execution plane with lazy operation graphs and backend planning. Phase 3 adds inference primitives.
